{{Quote|The Neo-Crusaders smashed a Republic task force at Commenor and ravaged Duro in 3962 BBY&mdash;but that was as far as they would get.|From [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[3962 BBY]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] campaigned to take control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an offensive they dubbed "[[Mandalorian Triumph]]." The charge consisted of two forces advancing Coreward, with one originating from Mandalorian territory that conquered several worlds before it [[Battle of the Zel system|passed through]] the [[Zel system]] and to Commenor.<ref name="Atlas" /> Once the Mandalorians defeated a Republic task force stationed on Commenor and took the world,<ref name="Warfare" /> they [[Battle of the Quellor system (Mandalorian Wars)|moved on]] to the [[Quellor system/Legends|Quellor system]], [[Battle of the Exodeen system (Mandalorian Wars)|then]] the [[Exodeen system/Legends|Exodeen system]], before finally [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|taking]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]] was marked on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing systems that hosted battles of the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Atlas" />
